# classic-laddie server diet: desktop duty leaves, 3080 Ti roster lands

classic-laddie is being split into two machines: a new desktop (weller) takes
over workstation/gaming duty and the 4090; classic-laddie keeps every server
role, moves into a small case under the stairs, and its GPU becomes a spare
RTX 3080 Ti (12GB). This PR strips the desktop half and resizes the LLM
roster for 12GB VRAM. It merges on the owner's schedule (timed to the
hardware surgery — the converge loop deploys main within the hour of merge),
so: normal PR, do NOT merge.

All changes in `hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix` unless noted. The diff
should show ONLY removals plus the roster change — resist any urge to
refactor.

## Remove (desktop duty)

- The `../../modules/common/desktop.nix` import.
- `modules.gaming.enable = true;` and `modules.ddcci.enable = true;`.
- `services.displayManager.autoLogin` block.
- `GDK_DPI_SCALE` from `environment.sessionVariables` — CAREFUL: that
  attribute set also carries `VALLEY_ATTEST_KEY` and `VALLEY_ATTEST_NAME`
  (merged recently in #756), which MUST stay. Remove only the GDK line and
  its Dell-monitor comment.
- The NZXT Kraken block: `services.udev.packages = [ pkgs.liquidctl ]`, the
  `1e71`/`3008` udev rule, and `systemd.services.kraken-lcd-orientation`
  (the cooler is being retired with the case swap).

## Keep (verify untouched by your removals)

- Everything in `hardware.nix` including the NVIDIA stack — the 3080 Ti uses
  the same driver; do not touch that file.
- media-server + recyclarr, reel-life, github-relay + its polkit rule, the
  valley host/integrator/identity/backup stack, cosmo-rebuild service+timer,
  home-assistant + the `networking.firewall.allowedTCPPorts = [ 8123 ]` line,
  PXE/tftp, tailscale (exit node), the klaus microVM + br-klaus bridge,
  libvirtd, crash-capture, ZFS mounts/tmpfiles, open-webui.
- After removing desktop.nix, check nothing orphaned references the display
  manager / graphical session (eval will tell you).

## Change: llama-swap roster for 12GB

The current models are 32B Q4_K_M (~20GB) sized for the departed 4090. For
the 3080 Ti (12GB), replace with ~14B-class Q4_K_M models, honest IDs (the
sole consumer is the local open-webui, which discovers models via the API —
IDs are free to change):

- `qwen2.5-coder:14b` → `bartowski/Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M`
- `qwen3:14b`         → `unsloth/Qwen3-14B-GGUF:Q4_K_M`
- `gemma3:12b`        → `unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it-GGUF:Q4_K_M`

Keep `-c 8192` and the ttl/idle-unload pattern. Update the section's header
comment: it currently says the stack fronts "one RTX 4090 (24GB)" with
32B sizing rationale — rewrite for the 3080 Ti (12GB), same terse register.
Verify each chosen GGUF repo actually exists on HuggingFace with that quant
(check with curl; a 404 model id fail-loops the swap at first request).

## Acceptance

- `nix flake check` passes — PASTE the final output lines.
- `nix build --dry-run .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel`
  evaluates cleanly — paste the tail.
- `git diff --stat` in the report; confirm the VALLEY_ATTEST vars survived
  and hardware.nix is untouched.
- Open the PR; do not merge (owner merges, timed to hardware surgery).
